action: Tested a cataloged part-three DOC attachment as a possible readable edition-level witness for the al-Farra reference in KSU note 8.

finding.catalog: Quranpedia's record labels the work 'Ma'ani al-Qur'an li al-Farra, muwafiqan lil-matbu'; its metadata credits Ahmad Yusuf Najati, publisher al-Dar al-Misriyya lil-Ta'lif wa-al-Tarjama, and one volume, while the page lists four part attachments.
finding.access: The part-three DOC link was retrieved by the web tool but rejected as application/msword unsupported content-type. The viewer link for the first part only displayed a pending file-fetch page; it did not expose a searchable page image or text.
finding.implication: This path does not provide a legible printed p.377, a colophon, or an edition match for KSU. Catalog labels are preserved as metadata only and cannot be treated as the same physical edition.

source_anchors.source: Quranpedia catalog, Ma'ani al-Qur'an muwafiqan lil-matbu
source_anchors.locator: HTML lines 2-4 identify title and publisher; lines 18-24 identify editor/publisher and state one volume; lines 34-40 list four part attachments.
Part 3 attachment linked from catalog; web reader rejects application/msword, so no page text or image was inspected.
Printed p.602, note 8 cites al-Farra p.377 without volume or edition.
Bare page 377 occurs across multiple volumes; not enough to identify KSU's source.
